canonical_states.strict_trace: all rounds including applicable set, winner/rank, consumed columns, and exact contribution
canonical_states.numerical: raw rows clustered at relative tolerance 1e-12
canonical_states.projected_full: (final remaining columns, exact IEEE-754 rows hex)
canonical_states.conservative_merge_safe: projected full state plus physical selected subset

counterexample.explanation: CE transitions commute, but q-error is nonlinear in the combined estimate.

correctness.note: Arbitrary-extension safety is claimed only for the conservative key containing the subset; projected-state failures are reported as counterexamples.
